correctness.rationale: Uniform proof: nonidentity lattice deck transformations move points by at least seven; all scale-two cliques lift isometrically into the Manhattan plane. Five enumerated phases, with every codimension-one free face uniquely covered in the surviving complex, perform exactly 9mn elementary collapses and leave the quotient square triangulation, a Klein bottle. The standard Klein-bottle cellular boundary yields integral \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z\), \(H_2=0\). A standalone complete-clique/collapse checker was replayed on four twisted and four control grids and returned VERIFY_OK; finite checks supplement but do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: The finite twisted rectangular grid is a natural discrete model of the nonorientable flat Klein bottle. At inclusive graph scale two, torsion Z/2 appears even though the scale-one graph has free first homology; this contrasts sharply with the known orientable torus-grid case. A uniform exact size cutoff, all rectangular parameter classification, and explicit 9mn elementary simple-homotopy collapse have motivated topological significance beyond a numerical test.
